## Context / Problem
The src/rebar/reconciler cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. Before citations use audit base `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192` and its former `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` paths. Current edit base is `7840899ea7ac0609bf3e0dec5e26effdbda1ec6c`; Scope paths below use `src/rebar/reconciler/`. Historical line ranges identify prose to map to current owners, not current edit coordinates.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.
